description: Free. Scripts you run on your own build, in its page, for what a checklist can’t prove: layout-probe measures that nothing moves when the view changes state (column edges, row tops, controls that come and go) and that every focus ring shows whole. Without an id, the list with what each proves and how to run it; with an id, the script itself as text. Run them at every width you claim and pass the results to check({ evidence }).

id.description: Optional: the check id, e.g. layout-probe.

name: get_check
title: Get a runnable check
